answers.q1: pnpm (pinned by package.json as pnpm@12.10.0; the preinstall hook runs `npx only-allow pnpm`, so npm and yarn are rejected). Install from the repo root with: pnpm install   (`pnpm i` is the same). Build before running playground tests with: pnpm build
answers.q2: pnpm test   (package.json runs `pnpm test:unit && pnpm test-serve && pnpm test-build`). CI also runs `pnpm run test-serve-bundled`, which `pnpm test` does not include. Run `pnpm build` first. Note that AGENTS.md says `pnpm test-unit`, but no such script exists. The real script name is `test:unit`.
answers.q3: pnpm test:unit packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts   (this runs `vitest run` with that path as a filter; the equivalent is `pnpm exec vitest run packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts`). AGENTS.md's `pnpm test-unit` is wrong, because the script is named `test:unit`.
answers.q4: CI's lint job runs these after `pnpm run build`: `pnpm run lint:js`, then `pnpm format && git diff --exit-code`, then `pnpm run typecheck`, then `pnpm run test-docs`. To run lint and formatting only: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint:js && pnpm format && git diff --exit-code. `pnpm format` runs oxfmt, which rewrites files; the `git diff --exit-code` that follows is what makes CI fail on unformatted code. AGENTS.md says `pnpm lint`, but that script doesn't exist. Use `lint:js`.
answers.q5: Do not hand-edit these. Build output and generated or cache files (all gitignored): dist/ directories such as packages/vite/dist, playground-temp/, node_modules/, .eslintcache, docs/.vitepress/cache and docs/.vitepress/.temp, and packages/vite/LICENSE (generated at build time). pnpm-lock.yaml is generated by pnpm, and packages/*/CHANGELOG.md is generated at release time. patches/ holds pnpm patch files (chokidar@3.6.0.patch, dotenv-expand@13.0.0.patch, sirv@3.0.2.patch), which should be regenerated with `pnpm patch`/`pnpm patch-commit` rather than edited by hand.
